description: Fork of exp611 (1.4047 @ 289M). Three dim changes: E (embedding/LUT-stream) 384 -> 256, d_v 64 -> 48, D (residual/output) 384 unchanged. d_qk=64, H=6, num_layers=6 unchanged. All LUT module SHAPES (tph, NAP) kept identical to exp611 — only dims rescale. Expected param breakdown: qkv_lut unchanged at 18.87M (n_out=2*d_qk=128 unchanged), v_lut -> 56.62M (was 75.50M, -19M from d_v 64->48), out_proj -> 100.66M (was 150.99M, -50M from n_out=E 384->256), read_out_lut unchanged at 18.87M (n_out=D=384 unchanged). tok_emb_E: 32768*256 = 8.39M (was 12.58M, -4M). unembedder unchanged 12.58M (D=384). Total: ~216M (vs exp611 289M, -25%). Tests co-adaptation theory: does exp611's architecture intrinsically work at smaller E if all module shapes scale together. References: exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp666 = 1.4544 @ 92.8M (current <100M SOTA), vanilla exp328 = 1.3882 @ 23.2M.
